correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md blob cbb49a92c755325bbf57d07adbb2a583fb7a0e35 and complete artifacts/verify_attractors.py blob 680a9c804a5bce0cccfd3bc181c94a89c216c037. Each distinct factor gives the exact union-of-occurrence-spans mask; every attractor is a hitting set for these masks, no implication gap. Inclusion-minimal masks preserve all hitting sets: 48 among 7008 distinct factors at n=128, 64 among 28128 at n=256. Supplied witnesses hit all original masks. A separately implemented exact recursive branch search with memoized no-solution states proved no hitting set of size ≤9 and ≤10, respectively, returning 243 and 3710 nodes (the source uses a different deterministic branch order with 243 and 3703). No timeout or sampled factors. This is a complete finite proof at these two sizes, not an extrapolation to all n.

evidence: Schaeffer–Shallit general results do not give these finite optima; Béal et al. algorithms can solve hitting sets but do not state these specific values.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A general decision/search algorithm is not itself a published exact result for an uncomputed case; prior certified inequalities leave multiple possible integer values.
